svg.title: Size policy spends overdraw to create simpler runs
svg.desc: Two panels reach the same final blue-and-amber pixel grid. Fast policy paints exact masks; size policy first fills the blue span and then repaints amber pixels, favoring repeatable SIXEL runs.
svg.text: Size policy spends overdraw to create simpler runs
Later colors repair the temporary fill, so the final indexed image is unchanged.
same final pixels • different SIXEL byte stream
